tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Code_iOS_Simulator__control
tools.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Code_iOS_Simulator__control
schema.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

app_path.description: For 'launch': absolute path (no ~) to the built .app bundle (e.g. /Users/me/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/MyApp-abc123/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/MyApp.app).

device.description: Simulator name (e.g. 'iPhone 17 Pro') or UDID. Defaults to the simulator already attached, else the first booted one. The first use of a device asks the user for permission.

udid.description: Alias for 'device' (identical semantics: simulator name or UDID). Pass at most one of 'device' / 'udid'.

bundle_id.description: For 'launch': bundle identifier. If omitted, extracted from the .app's Info.plist.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. count.description: For 'press_key': how many times to press it, 1 to 20 (default 1).

state.description: For 'set_keyboard': 'show' or 'hide' the on-screen keyboard. For 'set_appearance': 'light' or 'dark'.

40	## 2. Corrections to the lead's sketch
41	
42	1. **No state map `ρ`, no `ρ⁻¹`.** The relation is defined directly (`SRel π α s s'`, the
43	   unfolded form of `s' ≈ ρ s`). Building `ρ s` as a list needs default elements and the bounds
44	   `n ≤ |P|`, `r ≤ |A|`, and its inverse is only an inverse up to those bounds; every proof
45	   consumes the relation, never the map. `K.rename`'s `Satisfiable` is defined existentially over
46	   related states instead of through `ρ⁻¹` (item 6).
47	2. **`≈` is "equal up to `List.Perm`", not "same membership".** The owner accepted invariance of
48	   `Satisfiable` under *permutation* of footprint, anchor and pin-leaf lists. Membership
49	   equivalence relates more states (it ignores multiplicities), so a `KExt` stated with it would
50	   be a stronger hypothesis than the one accepted. `Perm` is preserved by every effect (section 4)
51	   and gives membership wherever a precondition needs it (`List.Perm.mem_iff`).
52	3. **`Ren` carries no `n`.** A renaming is a bijection of `Nat` with its inverse laws. "Identity on
53	   fresh identities" is a field of the relation (`PRel.fix`, `SRel.Afix`: identity from `|P|`,
54	   resp. `|A|`, on), established at init (`|P| = n`, `|A| = r`) and kept because lengths only
55	   grow and are equal on both sides.
56	4. **Link order is not a consequence of the relation.** `π` is not monotone, so downward parent
57	   and origin links in `s` say nothing about `s'`. `chainF` (`o < i`) and `corrF` (`p < r`) both
58	   truncate on non-downward links, so equivariance of `chain`, `partOf`, `footprint`, `ancs`,
59	   `effAnchor`, `corr` needs `Down s` **and** `Down s'`. Both are carried in `Sim` and preserved
60	   per step on each side (`op_down`); no `DDSound` hypothesis is needed. Effect states read by
61	   preconditions (`transferEff`, `storeEff`, `enterEff`, `exitEff`, `endUseS`, `endUseEff`,
62	   `freeS`, `freeEff`) need their own `Down`, proven from `Down s` plus at most an earlier
63	   conjunct (`enterEff`: `localsOK`).
64	5. **Field order is an invariant of the run, not only of `σ`.** `kids` lists children in index
65	   order and `corr` reads positions in it (§63.2). The relation needs `SibMono π s.P`: `π` is
66	   increasing on siblings. At init it is `ConsistentRenumbering.field_order`; it is preserved
67	   because places are only appended and appended places are fixed by `π` and larger than every
68	   older one. The sketch did not carry it through runs. A renaming that breaks it changes
69	   verdicts (section 7, R1, with a run).
70	6. **`K.rename`**: `DeclaredDisjoint` maps its lists exactly (`split` regions are arguments
71	   renamed elementwise in order, no extensionality needed); `FreeCompat p auth` renames `p` only,
72	   since `auth` "is opaque to the authority kernel" (§70.2); `ExternalDone` is not renamed
73	   (obligations keep their identities, appended in the same order on both sides);
74	   `Satisfiable p sh t := ∃ t₀, SRel π α t₀ t ∧ k.Satisfiable (π.g p) sh t₀`.
75	7. **Shapes are not renamed** (`enter ps ls`, `alloc pr ow ls`, and the `sh` of `Satisfiable`).
76	   `ShapeOK |P| ls` forces every parent and owning element to be `≥ |P|`, where `π` is the
77	   identity; `ShapeOK` depends only on `|P|` (equal on both sides) and `ls`, so rejections agree.
78	8. **Iff lemmas are proved in one direction**, then closed by symmetry (`SRel.symm`, `Sim.symm`,
79	   `KCorr.symm`). Preconditions that mention `K` are stated for any pair `k, k'` with
80	   `KCorr π α k k'`, because `(k.rename π α).rename π.symm α.symm` is not definitionally `k`.
81	9. **`I4` needs no transfer**: `i4_always` (Lemmas.lean) proves it for every state.
82	10. **Names**: `Corpus/MM23H.lean` opens `Ern.MemoryModel.Access` and defines its own `Sim`. All
83	    new names go in namespace `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename`, except the dot-notation functions
84	    `Holder.ren`, `Place.ren`, `K.rename`, `KernelOp.ren`, which go in
85	    `Ern.MemoryModel.Access`.

107	def Ren.id : Ren := ⟨fun i => i, fun i => i, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩

116	  f x := if x < n then τ.idxOf x else x
117	  g i := if hi : i < τ.length then τ[i] else i
118	  gf := …   -- compiled, section 8

28	**Name-shadowing pitfall (observed).** Inside the signature/body of a declaration named
29	`SRel.foo` (resp. `PRel.foo`), a short name `bar` resolves to `SRel.bar` (resp. `PRel.bar`) when
30	it exists. Kernel names shadowed this way: `effective`, `depsOf`, `mem_descModes`,
31	`mem_footprint`, `parentOf`. Write `Access.effective`, `Access.depsOf`, `Access.mem_descModes`,
32	`Access.mem_footprint`, `Access.parentOf` there. Dot notation on states (`s.pin`, `s.org`, `s.ancs`,
33	`s.pframe`, …) is not affected.

35	## Conventions
36	
37	`h : SRel π α s s'`, `hd : Down s`, `hd' : Down s'`, `hS : Sim π α s s'` (`hS.rel`, `hS.down`,
38	`hS.down'`, `hS.sib`), `hK : KCorr π α k k'`; place-level: `hP : PRel π P P'`, `hd : DownP P`,
39	`hd' : DownP P'`, `hs : SibMono π P`. From a `Sim`: `hS.rel.P`, `hS.down.1`, `hS.down'.1`.
40	"f-form" `π.f l ∈ L' ↔ l ∈ L`; g-form via `Ren.mem_iff_g`.
41	Closing an iff by symmetry: `h.symm : SRel π.symm α.symm s' s`; `Ren.symm_f : π.symm.f i = π.g i`
42	(simp) and `π.gf`: e.g. `fun h' => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using h.symm.usable_of h'`.
43	For closed statements (no renamed argument), `h.symm.foo_of hd' hd` directly.

117	  (∀ o, R o → ∃ o', R' o' ∧ OutRel π α o o') ∧ ∀ o', R' o' → ∃ o, R o ∧ OutRel π α o o'

596	| R1 | `kids`, `posIn`, `corr` (§63.2, `transfer`) | Positions in index-ordered children. A renaming that reverses fields changes `corr`, hence holders and owners after `transfer`. Checked with the corpus runner: `st1` = src 0 {1,2} Init, dst 3 {4,5}, static 6 owned by static 1; `σ = swap 4 5` maps `st1` to itself (both numberings `StaticsOK`) but breaks `field_order`. `[transfer 0 3, endUse 4, pin 6]` gives `[ok, ok, reject]`; the renamed `[transfer 0 3, endUse 5, pin 6]` gives `[ok, ok, ok]`. | `ConsistentRenumbering.field_order` gives `SibMono` at init; `Sim.sib` carries it; appended places keep it (`shapeP_sib`); `kids_ren`, `corr_ren` (compiled). |

Effect states read by preconditions get `XEff_down` from `Down s` (enter: under `localsOK`). Fuel handled by `chain_cons`, `corr_step` (existing, through `chainF_fuel`, `corrF_fuel`). |

Example: root R with fields A {a1} and b; numbered `[R, A, b, a1]` the list is `[b, a1]`, numbered `[R, A, a1, b]` it is `[a1, b]`. | `Perm` in `AuthRel.footprint`, `PinRel.leaves`. 11	## Namespaces
12	
13	Everything is in `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename`, except the four functions
14	`Holder.ren`, `Place.ren`, `K.rename`, `KernelOp.ren` (in `Ern.MemoryModel.Access`, so dot
15	notation works: `o.ren π`, `pl.ren π`, `k.rename π α`, `op.ren π α`).
16	Lemmas *about* them are in `Rename` too: `Rename.Holder.ren_symm`, `Rename.KernelOp.ren_symm_ren`, …
17	(call them as `Holder.ren_symm π o` from inside `namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename`; dot
18	notation `o.ren_symm` does NOT work).

21	
22	```lean
23	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename.Derived
24	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename
25	variable {π α : Ren} {s s' : S3} {k k' : K}

28	**Name-shadowing pitfall (observed).** Inside the signature/body of a declaration named
29	`SRel.foo` (resp. `PRel.foo`), a short name `bar` resolves to `SRel.bar` (resp. `PRel.bar`) when
30	it exists. Kernel names shadowed this way: `effective`, `depsOf`, `mem_descModes`,
31	`mem_footprint`, `parentOf`. Write `Access.effective`, `Access.depsOf`, `Access.mem_descModes`,
32	`Access.mem_footprint`, `Access.parentOf` there. Dot notation on states (`s.pin`, `s.org`, `s.ancs`,
33	`s.pframe`, …) is not affected.

35	## Conventions
36	
37	`h : SRel π α s s'`, `hd : Down s`, `hd' : Down s'`, `hS : Sim π α s s'` (`hS.rel`, `hS.down`,
38	`hS.down'`, `hS.sib`), `hK : KCorr π α k k'`; place-level: `hP : PRel π P P'`, `hd : DownP P`,
39	`hd' : DownP P'`, `hs : SibMono π P`. From a `Sim`: `hS.rel.P`, `hS.down.1`, `hS.down'.1`.
40	"f-form" `π.f l ∈ L' ↔ l ∈ L`; g-form via `Ren.mem_iff_g`.
41	Closing an iff by symmetry: `h.symm : SRel π.symm α.symm s' s`; `Ren.symm_f : π.symm.f i = π.g i`
42	(simp) and `π.gf`: e.g. `fun h' => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using h.symm.usable_of h'`.
43	For closed statements (no renamed argument), `h.symm.foo_of hd' hd` directly.

60	def Place.ren (π : Ren) (pl : Place) : Place := ⟨pl.parent.map π.f, pl.owner.ren π, pl.kind⟩

63	  mode : y'.mode = y.mode
64	  origin : y'.origin = y.origin.map α.f

69	  place : ob'.place = π.f ob.place
70	  leaves : ob'.leaves.Perm (ob.leaves.map π.f)
71	  active : ob'.active = ob.active

73	  len : P'.length = P.length
74	  get : ∀ q, P'[π.f q]? = (P[q]?).map (Place.ren π)
75	  fix : ∀ q, P.length ≤ q → π.f q = q
76	structure SRel (π α : Ren) (s s' : S3) : Prop where
77	  F : s'.F = s.F
78	  nF : s'.nF = s.nF

80	  I : ∀ l, s'.I (π.f l) = s.I l
81	  Alen : s'.A.length = s.A.length

83	  Afix : ∀ x, s.A.length ≤ x → α.f x = x

88	def DownA (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ j o, s.org j = some o → o < j
89	def Down (s : S3) : Prop := DownP s.P ∧ DownA s
90	def SibMono (π : Ren) (P : List Place) : Prop :=
91	  ∀ x y p, parentOf P x = some p → parentOf P y = some p → x < y → π.f x < π.f y

93	  rel : SRel π α s s'
94	  down : Down s
95	  down' : Down s'
96	  sib : SibMono π s.P

98	  ∀ p sh s t, SRel Ren.id Ren.id s t → k.Satisfiable p sh s → k.Satisfiable p sh t
99	def K.rename (π α : Ren) (k : K) : K where
100	  DeclaredDisjoint r r' := k.DeclaredDisjoint (r.map π.g) (r'.map π.g)
101	  SharedMutable l := k.SharedMutable (π.g l)
102	  Pinned l := k.Pinned (π.g l)
103	  ExternalDone o := k.ExternalDone o
104	  Deallocable p := k.Deallocable (π.g p)
105	  FreeCompat p a := k.FreeCompat (π.g p) a
106	  Satisfiable p sh t := ∃ t₀, SRel π α t₀ t ∧ k.Satisfiable (π.g p) sh t₀
107	def KernelOp.ren (π α : Ren) : KernelOp → KernelOp    -- exactly the table of design §3
108	structure KCorr (π α : Ren) (k k' : K) : Prop where
109	  dd : ∀ r r', k'.DeclaredDisjoint (r.map π.f) (r'.map π.f) ↔ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r'
110	  shared : ∀ l, k'.SharedMutable (π.f l) ↔ k.SharedMutable l
111	  pinned : ∀ l, k'.Pinned (π.f l) ↔ k.Pinned l
112	  done : ∀ o, k'.ExternalDone o ↔ k.ExternalDone o
113	  dealloc : ∀ p, k'.Deallocable (π.f p) ↔ k.Deallocable p
114	  compat : ∀ p a, k'.FreeCompat (π.f p) a ↔ k.FreeCompat p a
115	def OutRel (π α : Ren) : Outcome3 S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop   -- ok/ok: SRel; reject/reject, fail/fail: True
116	def StepCorr (π α : Ren) (R R' : Outcome3 S3 → Prop) : Prop :=
117	  (∀ o, R o → ∃ o', R' o' ∧ OutRel π α o o') ∧ ∀ o', R' o' → ∃ o, R o ∧ OutRel π α o o'

instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Write3Pre s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ s.ExercisableAt a .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- Effect of a write (§67, §68, `ok` effect): the written leaves become `Init`. -/
def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }

/-- `write` as a relation (§67). -/
def Write3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Write3Pre s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)

/-- Preconditions of `writeShared` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§68). -/
structure WriteSharedPre (k : K) (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is usable (belongs to a usable place). -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is declared `K.SharedMutable`. -/
  shared : ∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l
  /-- §68.2: `access` is exercisable in a mode at least `Observe`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
  /-- §68.2: `access` has a present effective mode on every leaf. -/
  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
  /-- §68.3: dependencies are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `writeShared` (§68). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) :
    Decidable (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l) ∧
    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `writeShared` as a relation (§68). -/
def WriteSharedStep (k : K) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)

/-! ## Release of authorities whose holder dies (§69, §70) -/

/-- Releases every authority whose holder is no longer live (§69, §70 `ok` effects). -/
def cleanup (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A.map fun y => if HolderLive s y.holder then y else { y with active := false } }

/-! ## O12 `endUse` (§69) -/

/-- `endUse p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§69, `ok` effect): the leaves of
`p` become `Uninit`; authorities held within `p` are released; anchors of `p` and its parts are
removed; storage owned by `p`, transitively, is marked dead. -/
def endUseS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (OwnedIn s.P p q)
    A := s.A.map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `endUse p` (§69, `ok` effect): `endUseS`, then the authorities whose holder died
are released. -/
def endUseEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (endUseS s p)

/-- Leaf whose use ends with the value at `p` (§69.2, §69.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that
stops being usable. -/
def EndingLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (endUseS s p).Usable l)

/-- Decidability of `EndingLeaf` (§69). -/
instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (EndingLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold EndingLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Root authority of the value at `p` (§69.3): an authority with no origin covering a leaf of
`p`. -/
def IsRootOf (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
  y.origin = none ∧ ∃ l ∈ footprint s.P p, l ∈ y.footprint

/-- Decidability of `IsRootOf` (§69.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Decidable (IsRootOf s p y) := by
  unfold IsRootOf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block `endUse p` (§69.2): if it is an active derived authority over an
ending leaf, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def EndUseAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, EndingLeaf s p l) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `EndUseAccessOK` (§69.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold EndUseAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives `endUse p` (§69.3): not held within `p`, not a root of `p`, with a holder
that stays live. -/
def EndUseAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧ ¬ IsRootOf s p y ∧
    HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `EndUseAnchorOK` (§69.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
structure EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §69.1: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §69.1: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §69.2: no active derived authority over an ending leaf is held outside the dying places,
  except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`: some
  authority grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  access : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ EndUseAccessOK s p j
  /-- §69.2, last sentence: no authority that the effect makes inactive has an active descendant
  that the effect does not make inactive. -/
  keptDesc : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
    ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active j
  /-- §69.3: no place usable after the effect depends on an authority held by `place`, its root,
  or an authority whose holder dies. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x
  /-- §69.4: no ending leaf, owned storage included, is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (EndUsePre k s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ EndUseAccessOK s p j) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
      ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `endUse` as a relation (§69). -/
def EndUseStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EndUsePre k s p) (endUseEff s p)

/-! ## O13 `free` (§70) -/

/-- The holder is a place (§70.1). -/
def Holder.isPlace : Holder → Bool
  | .place _ => true
  | .frame _ => false

/-- `OwnedRoot` (§70.1): a place with no structural parent, owned by a place. -/
def OwnedRoot (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.P[p]?) (fun pl => pl.parent = none ∧ pl.owner.isPlace = true) False

/-- Decidability of `OwnedRoot` (§70.1). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedRoot s p) := by
  unfold OwnedRoot; infer_instance

/-- Place `q` belongs to the unit released by `free p` (§70): a part of `p`, or storage owned by
`p`, transitively. -/
def FreedPlace (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := partOf P q p ∨ OwnedIn P p q

/-- Decidability of `FreedPlace` (§70). -/
instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (FreedPlace P p q) := by
  unfold FreedPlace; infer_instance

/-- `free p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§70, `ok` effect): the released unit
is marked dead; authorities covering it, roots included, or held within `p` become inactive. -/
def freeS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (FreedPlace s.P p q)
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then
        { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `free p` (§70, `ok` effect): `freeS`, then the authorities whose holder died are
released. -/
def freeEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (freeS s p)

/-- Leaf of the released unit (§70.3, §70.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that stops being
usable. -/
def FreedLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (freeS s p).Usable l)

/-- Decidability of `FreedLeaf` (§70). -/
instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (FreedLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold FreedLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block `free p` (§70.3): if it is an active derivative over the
footprint being freed, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def FreeAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedLeaf s p l) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `FreeAccessOK` (§70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold FreeAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives `free p` (§70.3): it covers no leaf of the released unit, is not held
within `p`, and its holder stays live. -/
def FreeAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧
    HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `FreeAnchorOK` (§70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold FreeAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `free p auth` (§70). -/
structure FreePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §70.1: `place` is an `OwnedRoot`. -/
  ownedRoot : OwnedRoot s p
  /-- §70.2: `K.Deallocable(place)`. -/
  deallocable : k.Deallocable p
  /-- §70.2: `K.FreeCompat(place, auth)`. -/
  freeCompat : k.FreeCompat p auth
  /-- §70.3: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §70.3: no active derivative over the footprint being freed is held outside dying holders,
  except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`: some
  authority grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  access : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ FreeAccessOK s p j
  /-- §70.3, last sentence: no authority that the effect makes inactive has an active descendant
  that the effect does not make inactive. -/
  keptDesc : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
    ¬ (freeEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (freeEff s p).Active j
  /-- §70.3: no surviving place is anchored to an authority of the released unit or of its dead
  holders. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x
  /-- §70.4: no leaf of the released unit is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `free` (§70). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
    [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) :
    Decidable (FreePre k s p auth) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OwnedRoot s p ∧ k.Deallocable p ∧ k.FreeCompat p auth ∧
    HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ FreeAccessOK s p j) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
      ¬ (freeEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (freeEff s p).Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- `free` as a relation (§70). -/
def FreeStep (k : K) (p auth : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (FreePre k s p auth) (freeEff s p)

/-! ## O14 `alloc` (§71) -/

/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (§71, items 1–3). -/
structure AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- §71.1: the shape is nonempty. -/
  nonempty : ls ≠ []
  /-- §71.1: the shape is represented like the locals of `enterFrame` (each parent is an earlier
  element). -/
  shapeOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- §71.1 with the `ok` outcome of §71 ("a new storage root"): exactly one element has no
  parent. -/
  oneRoot : (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1
  /-- §71.2: the provider is a usable place. -/
  providerUsable : s.Usable provider
  /-- §71.2: all leaves of the provider are `Init`. -/
  providerInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init
  /-- §71.2: metadata updates are permitted through exercisable `Modify` on the provider or a
  valid `writeShared` (§68) over its leaves. -/
  providerRight : HasRight s .modify provider ∨
    ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)
  /-- §71.3: exercisable `Modify` over `owner`. -/
  ownerRight : HasRight s .modify owner
  /-- §71.3 (liveness restrictions): `owner` is usable. -/
  ownerUsable : s.Usable owner

/-- Decidability of the static preconditions of `alloc` (§71). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
    (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (ls ≠ [] ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1 ∧
    s.Usable provider ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (HasRight s .modify provider ∨
      ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)) ∧
    HasRight s .modify owner ∧ s.Usable owner)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- Places after `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): the elements of the shape appended, owned by
`owner`. -/
def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place :=
  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls.toShape

/-- Effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): a new storage root of fresh identities owned by
`owner`, its leaves `Uninit`, no anchor, alive, with a root `Modify` authority with no origin held
by `owner`; pinning obligations are unchanged. -/
def allocEff (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := allocP s owner ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.place owner) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q }

/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (§71 outcomes, §58): `reject` when a static
precondition fails; `fail`, state unchanged, when `K.Satisfiable` is false; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
    Outcome3 S3 → Prop where
  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s owner ls))
  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s .fail
  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject

/-! ## O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin` (§74, §75) -/

/-- Preconditions of `pin` (§74). "Applicable pinning obligations" is not represented. -/
structure PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §74: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §74: exercisable `Modify` over the leaves of `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `pin` (§74). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `pin` (§74, `ok` effect): an active dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity
`|pins|` is installed on the leaves of `place`. -/
def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins ++ [⟨p, footprint s.P p, true⟩] }

/-- `pin` as a relation (§74). -/
def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p)

/-- Effect of `unpin` (§75, `ok` effect): the designated obligation `o` ends, and only that
one. -/
def unpinEff (s : S3) (o : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins.modify o fun ob => { ob with active := false } }

/-- Preconditions of `unpin o` (§75), `o` the identity of a dynamic pinning obligation. -/
structure UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (o : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §75: `unpin` designates an active dynamic pinning obligation. -/
  active : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False
  /-- §75: `place`, on which the obligation was installed by `pin`, is usable. -/
  usable : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False
  /-- §75: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False
  /-- §75: `K.ExternalDone`, applied to the obligation. -/
  externalDone : k.ExternalDone o

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (o : Nat) :
    Decidable (UnpinPre k s o) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False ∧ k.ExternalDone o)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
def UnpinStep (k : K) (o : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (UnpinPre k s o) (unpinEff s o)

/-! ## Kernel steps (§57, §58) -/

/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75; §57 reachability). -/
inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {o : Nat} : UnpinStep k o s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

inductive Holder where
  | frame (f : Nat)
  | place (p : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Logical place (§40): optional structural parent, owner, abstract `kind`. Its identity is its
index in `P`; its death marker is `S3.dead`. -/
structure Place where
  parent : Option Nat
  owner : Holder
  kind : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Structural parent of place `i` (§40). -/
def parentOf (P : List Place) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (P[i]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- `partOf(p, q)` (§40): `p` is a place of `P` and `q` is `p` or one of its structural
ancestors. -/
def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)

/-- Decidability of `partOf` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (partOf P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- Leaf (§40): a place with no structural child. -/
def isLeaf (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Prop := ∀ r < P.length, parentOf P r ≠ some l

/-- Decidability of `isLeaf` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Decidable (isLeaf P l) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _, _))

/-- `footprint(q)` (§40): the leaves of `P` that are parts of `q`. -/
def footprint (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q)

/-- Two places overlap when their footprints share a leaf (§63.3). -/
def overlap (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ∃ l ∈ footprint P p, l ∈ footprint P q

/-- Decidability of `overlap` (§63.3). -/
instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (overlap P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- `OwnedIn P src q` (§40, §33): the ownership chain of `q` reaches a place owned by `src` or by
one of its parts, that is, `q` is storage owned, directly or transitively, by the value at
`src`. -/
inductive OwnedIn (P : List Place) (src : Nat) : Nat → Prop where
  | direct {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → partOf P o src →
      OwnedIn P src q
  | step {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → OwnedIn P src o →
      OwnedIn P src q

/-! ## State (§38, §41, §42) -/

/-- Initialization state of a leaf (§41). -/
inductive InitSt where
  | uninit
  | init
  | moved
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Mode of an authority or of a request (§42, §43). -/
inductive Mode where
  | observe
  | modify
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Order of requested modes, `Observe ≤ Modify` (§43). -/
def Mode.le (m m' : Mode) : Prop := m = .observe ∨ m' = .modify

/-- Decidability of the mode order (§43). -/
instance (m m' : Mode) : Decidable (m.le m') := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∨ _))

/-- Authority (§42): own mode, optional origin, footprint (a list of leaves read
extensionally), holder, activity. Its identity is its index in `A`. -/
structure Authority where
  mode : Mode
  origin : Option Nat
  footprint : List Nat
  holder : Holder
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Dynamic pinning obligation (§74, §75): the place `pin` was applied to, the leaves it pins, and
whether it is still active. Its identity is its index in `S3.pins`. -/
structure PinOb where
  place : Nat
  leaves : List Nat
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State `S3` (§38). `F`, `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` are the components of §38. `nF` (next fresh frame
identity, §39), `dead` (death marker of places, §40) and `pins` (dynamic pinning obligations,
§74, §75) are auxiliary information that creates no right (§38). -/
structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (§74): an active pinning obligation covers it. -/
def S3.pin (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Bool := s.pins.any fun o => o.active && o.leaves.contains l

/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
receiving the shape. -/
abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)

/-- External contract `K` (§48, §80): `DeclaredDisjoint` on regions (§23, §61.3);
`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` on dynamic pinning
obligations, by identity (§75); `Deallocable` on places (§70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2);
`Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of `K` are hypotheses of theorems, never
fields. -/
structure K where
  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
  Pinned : Nat → Prop
  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop

/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/

/-- `Usable(s, p)` (§40, items 1–3): `p` exists, is not marked dead, and its owner is a frame of
the stack or a usable place. Inductive, so an ownership cycle makes no place usable (§40). -/
inductive S3.Usable (s : S3) : Nat → Prop where
  | frame {q f : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → s.dead q = false →
      pl.owner = .frame f → f ∈ s.F → S3.Usable s q
  | place {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → s.dead q = false →
      pl.owner = .place o → S3.Usable s o → S3.Usable s q

/-- A usable place exists (§40, item 1). -/
theorem S3.Usable.lt {s : S3} {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) : q < s.P.length := by
  cases h <;> exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›

/-- One step of `Usable` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §40). -/
def usableR (s : S3) (U : Nat → Bool) (q : Nat) : Bool :=
  match s.P[q]? with
  | some pl => !s.dead q && match pl.owner with
    | .frame f => decide (f ∈ s.F)
    | .place o => decide (o < s.P.length) && U o
  | none => false

/-- The place case of `usableR` (decision procedure for §40). -/
theorem usableR_place {s : S3} {U : Nat → Bool} {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} (hpl : s.P[q]? = some pl)
    (hd : s.dead q = false) (ho : pl.owner = .place o) (hlt : o < s.P.length) (hU : U o = true) :
    usableR s U q = true := by
  simp [usableR, hpl, hd, ho, hlt, hU]

/-- `usableR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §40). -/
theorem usableR_rule (s : S3) : KRule s.P.length (usableR s) where
  mono p q hpq a h := by
    unfold usableR at h ⊢; split at h
    · split at h <;> simp_all
    · exact h
  bound p a h := by
    unfold usableR at h; split at h
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · cases h
  loc p q hpq a := by
    unfold usableR; split
    · split
      · rfl
      · rename_i o _; by_cases ho : o < s.P.length <;> simp [ho, hpq o]
    · rfl

/-- Soundness of the iteration for `Usable` (decision procedure for §40). -/
theorem usable_of_kiter (s : S3) : ∀ k q, kiter (usableR s) k q = true → s.Usable q
  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
  | k + 1, q, h => by
    simp only [kiter, usableR] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i pl hpl
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at h
      obtain ⟨hd, h⟩ := h
      split at h
      · exact .frame hpl hd ‹_› (by simpa using h)
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
        exact .place hpl hd ‹_› (usable_of_kiter s k _ h.2)
    · cases h

/-- `Usable` is computed by `|P| + 1` steps of `usableR` (decision procedure for §40). -/
theorem usable_iff {s : S3} {q : Nat} :
    s.Usable q ↔ kiter (usableR s) (s.P.length + 1) q = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, usable_of_kiter s _ q⟩
  induction h with
  | frame hpl hd ho hf =>
    show usableR s _ _ = true
    simp [usableR, hpl, hd, ho, hf]
  | place hpl hd ho hu ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (usableR_rule s)]
    show usableR s _ _ = true
    exact usableR_place hpl hd ho hu.lt ih

/-- Decidability of `Usable` (§40). -/
instance (s : S3) (q : Nat) : Decidable (s.Usable q) := decidable_of_iff _ usable_iff.symm

/-- Live holder (§49.8): a frame of the stack or a usable place. -/
def HolderLive (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f ∈ s.F
  | .place p => s.Usable p

/-- Decidability of `HolderLive` (§49.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderLive s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderLive <;> infer_instance

/-! ## Frame of a place (§40, §44) -/

unfold SameShape; infer_instance

/-- Holder within the value at `q` (§63, §69, §70): `q` or one of its parts. -/
def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place r => partOf P r q
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `heldIn` (§63). -/
instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance

/-- Holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (§63, `ok` effect): part `r` of `src` becomes
`corr(r)`. Applied to holders within `src` only. -/
def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
  | .frame f => .frame f
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## Shapes (§47, §71.1, §72) -/

/-- A local shape as a shape whose elements have no owning element (§71.1, §72: locals and
allocated storage are owned by the receiving holder). -/
def LocalShape.toShape (ls : LocalShape) : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) :=
  ls.map fun e => (e.1, none, e.2)

/-- Owner of element `i` of a shape (§47, §72, §71): its owning element if any, `hd`
otherwise. -/
def shapeOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => hd

/-- Places `P` followed by the elements of a shape (§47, §71, §72): (parent, owning element,
kind), owned by their owning element or by `hd`. -/
def shapeP (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    List Place :=
  P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩

/-- Well-formed shape at offset `n` (§72.2, §71.1; for statics, the hypothesis recorded for
§47): the parent and the owning element of an element are earlier elements, and a part has the
owning element of its parent. -/
def ShapeOK (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - n]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => n ≤ o ∧ o < n + i) True

/-- Decidability of `ShapeOK` (§72.2, §71.1). -/
instance (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (ShapeOK n ls) := by
  unfold ShapeOK; infer_instance

/-- Indices of the root elements (no parent) of a shape (§40 root places; §47, §71, §72). -/
def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (§72) -/

/-- Places after `enterFrame` (§72, `ok` effect): the locals appended, owned by the new frame. -/
def enterP (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place := shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls.toShape

/-- Decidability of `Allows` (§43). -/
instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
  unfold Allows; infer_instance

/-- Footprint of authority `a` (§42), empty if it does not exist. -/
def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => x.footprint
  | none => []

/-- Adds an authority with fresh identity `s.A.length` (§42, §60). -/
def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

/-! ## Exercisable authorities (§43) -/

/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
the current frame, or by a place `p` such that an authority itself exercisable at `m` has an
effective mode permitting `m` on every leaf of `p`. Inductive along the holder chain (§43), so no
holder cycle justifies a right. -/
inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m

/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §43). -/
def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
  | none => false

/-- `any` depends only on the values of the predicate on the list (decision procedure for
§43). -/
theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
    l.any f = l.any g
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]

/-- `exR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
  mono p q hpq a h := by
    unfold exR at h ⊢; split at h
    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
      · simpa using h.2
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
    · exact h
  bound p a h := by
    unfold exR at h; split at h
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · cases h
  loc p q hpq a := by
    unfold exR; split
    · congr 1; split
      · rfl
      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
    · rfl

/-- Soundness of the iteration for `ExercisableAt` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
  | k + 1, a, h => by
    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i y hy
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
      split at h
      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
      · rename_i p hp
        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
    · cases h

/-- The frame-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]

/-- The place-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩

/-- `ExercisableAt` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
  induction h with
  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih

/-- Decidability of `ExercisableAt` (§43). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm

/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43): the current frame has an authority exercisable at `m` whose
effective mode permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m

/-- Decidability of `HasRight` (§43). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

/-- Authority `g` grounds the right `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3: "the
exercisable authority on which that right rests"): it is exercisable at `m` and its effective mode
permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def Grounds (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Prop :=
  g ∈ List.range s.A.length ∧ s.ExercisableAt g m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s g l) m

/-- Decidability of `Grounds` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Decidable (Grounds s m q g) := by
  unfold Grounds; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` is the grounding authority `g` or belongs to its origin chain (§63.4, §69.2,
§70.3: "the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain"). -/
def RightChain (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Prop := j = g ∨ j ∈ s.ancs g

/-- Decidability of `RightChain` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (RightChain s g j) := by
  unfold RightChain; infer_instance

/-! ## Dependencies and anchors (§44) -/

/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (§44: dependencies of contained values
are accounted for transitively). -/

/-- `Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail` (§58). `fail` leaves the state unchanged and
carries none. -/
inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
  | ok (s : σ)
  | reject
  | fail

/-- A kernel transition other than `alloc` (§58): `ok` with the effect when the preconditions
hold, `reject` otherwise; never `fail`. -/
inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Renaming of identities: core definitions

Foundation of the renaming bisimulation of the access kernel for
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §49, last paragraph: renamings of place and
authority identities (`Ren`), the relation they induce on places, authorities, pinning
obligations (§74, §75) and states (§38), the order facts carried along runs (`Down`, `SibMono`),
the renamed contract (§48, §80), the renamed operations (§60–§75), and the relation of outcomes
(§58). Generic lemmas on these relations, closed by symmetry.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace Rename

/-! ## Renamings (§49, last paragraph) -/

/-- A renaming of identities (§49, last paragraph): a bijection of `Nat` with its inverse. -/
structure Ren where
  f : Nat → Nat
  g : Nat → Nat
  gf : ∀ i, g (f i) = i
  fg : ∀ i, f (g i) = i

/-- The identity renaming (§49, last paragraph). -/
def Ren.id : Ren := ⟨fun i => i, fun i => i, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩

/-- The inverse renaming (§49, last paragraph). -/
def Ren.symm (π : Ren) : Ren := ⟨π.g, π.f, π.fg, π.gf⟩

/-- Composition of renamings, `π` first (§49, last paragraph). -/
def Ren.comp (π' π : Ren) : Ren :=
  ⟨fun i => π'.f (π.f i), fun i => π.g (π'.g i), fun i => by simp [π'.gf, π.gf],
   fun i => by simp [π'.fg, π.fg]⟩

/-- Renaming of a permutation `τ` of `List.range n` (§49, last paragraph): old `x < n` goes to its
position in `τ`, new `i < n` comes from `τ[i]`; identity from `n` on. -/
def Ren.ofPerm (τ : List Nat) (n : Nat) (h : τ.Perm (List.range n)) : Ren where
  f x := if x < n then τ.idxOf x else x
  g i := if hi : i < τ.length then τ[i] else i
  gf x := by
    have hl : τ.length = n := by simpa using h.length_eq
    by_cases hx : x < n
    · have hm : x ∈ τ := h.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hx)
      have hi := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hm
      simp [hx, hi, List.getElem_idxOf hi]
    · simp [hx, hl]
  fg i := by
    have hl : τ.length = n := by simpa using h.length_eq
    have hnd : τ.Nodup := h.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
    by_cases hi : i < τ.length
    · have hlt : τ[i] < n := List.mem_range.1 (h.mem_iff.1 (List.getElem_mem hi))
      simp only [hi, dite_true, hlt, ite_true]
      exact (List.Nodup.getElem_inj hnd).1
        (List.getElem_idxOf (List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (List.getElem_mem hi)))
    · simp [hi, hl ▸ hi]

/-- The inverse of `π` maps forward by `π.g` (§49, last paragraph). -/
@[simp] theorem Ren.symm_f (π : Ren) (i : Nat) : π.symm.f i = π.g i := rfl

/-- The inverse of `π` maps backward by `π.f` (§49, last paragraph). -/
@[simp] theorem Ren.symm_g (π : Ren) (i : Nat) : π.symm.g i = π.f i := rfl

/-- The inverse of the inverse is the renaming (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.symm_symm (π : Ren) : π.symm.symm = π := rfl

/-- A renaming is injective (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.f_inj (π : Ren) {i j : Nat} : π.f i = π.f j ↔ i = j :=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← π.gf i, h, π.gf], fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩

/-- A renaming is determined by its forward map (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.ext {π π' : Ren} (h : ∀ i, π.f i = π'.f i) : π = π' := by
  have hg : ∀ i, π.g i = π'.g i := fun i =>
    calc π.g i = π.g (π.f (π'.g i)) := by rw [h, π'.fg]
      _ = π'.g i := π.gf _
  obtain ⟨f, g, _, _⟩ := π
  obtain ⟨f', g', _, _⟩ := π'
  simp only [Ren.mk.injEq]
  exact ⟨funext h, funext hg⟩

/-- A renaming composed with its inverse is the identity (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.symm_comp (π : Ren) : π.symm.comp π = Ren.id := Ren.ext fun i => π.gf i

/-- Mapping by `π.f` then `π.g` is the identity on lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.map_gf (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) : (l.map π.f).map π.g = l := by
  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, π.gf]

/-- Mapping by `π.g` then `π.f` is the identity on lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.map_fg (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) : (l.map π.g).map π.f = l := by
  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, π.fg]

/-- Membership in a renamed list, read backward (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.mem_map (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) (y : Nat) : y ∈ l.map π.f ↔ π.g y ∈ l := by
  constructor
  · intro hy; obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; rwa [π.gf]
  · intro hy; exact List.mem_map.2 ⟨π.g y, hy, π.fg y⟩

/-- Membership of a renamed identity in a renamed list (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.mem_map_f (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) (x : Nat) : π.f x ∈ l.map π.f ↔ x ∈ l := by
  rw [π.mem_map, π.gf]

/-- The f-form of a membership correspondence gives its g-form (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.mem_iff_g (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (h : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L) (y : Nat) :
    y ∈ L' ↔ π.g y ∈ L := by rw [← h, π.fg]

/-- Universal quantification over all identities, renamed (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.forall_iff (π : Ren) {Q Q' : Nat → Prop} (hQ : ∀ x, Q' (π.f x) ↔ Q x) :
    (∀ y, Q' y) ↔ ∀ x, Q x :=
  ⟨fun h x => (hQ x).1 (h _), fun h y => by rw [← π.fg y]; exact (hQ _).2 (h _)⟩

/-- Universal quantification over corresponding lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.forall_mem_iff (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (hL : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L)
    {Q Q' : Nat → Prop} (hQ : ∀ x, Q' (π.f x) ↔ Q x) :
    (∀ y ∈ L', Q' y) ↔ ∀ x ∈ L, Q x :=
  ⟨fun h x hx => (hQ x).1 (h _ ((hL x).2 hx)),
   fun h y hy => by
    rw [← π.fg y] at hy ⊢; exact (hQ _).2 (h _ ((hL _).1 hy))⟩

/-- Existential quantification over corresponding lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.exists_mem_iff (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (hL : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L)
    {Q Q' : Nat → Prop} (hQ : ∀ x, Q' (π.f x) ↔ Q x) :
    (∃ y ∈ L', Q' y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ L, Q x :=
  ⟨fun ⟨y, hy, hq⟩ => by
    rw [← π.fg y] at hy hq; exact ⟨_, (hL _).1 hy, (hQ _).1 hq⟩,
   fun ⟨x, hx, hq⟩ => ⟨_, (hL x).2 hx, (hQ x).2 hq⟩⟩

/-- Duplicate-free lists with corresponding members are permutations up to renaming (§42: sets
represented by lists; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.perm_of_mem (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (hnd : L.Nodup) (hnd' : L'.Nodup)
    (h : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L) : L'.Perm (L.map π.f) := by
  have hm : (L.map π.f).Nodup :=
    List.pairwise_map.2 (hnd.imp fun hab e => hab ((Ren.f_inj π).1 e))
  refine (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup hnd' hm).2 fun y => ?_
  rw [π.mem_iff_g h, π.mem_map]

/-- A duplicate-free list of `n` identities below `n` is a permutation of `List.range n` (§49,
